Composting in a small flat

A worm bin under the sink handles a surprising amount of kitchen waste. Start with a shallow plastic tub, drill ventilation holes in the lid and line it with damp shredded paper.

Feed the worms small amounts of vegetable scraps and avoid citrus, onion and anything oily. If the bin smells sour, you have added too much at once, so pause feeding for a few days.

After about three months you will have dark crumbly castings. Use them as a top dressing for houseplants, a small handful at a time.
